common_mistakes.mistake: Pac steps off CATCH before the outgoing projectile has carried the sac across the receiver gate.
common_mistakes.consequence: The gate closes too soon and stops the outgoing sac before it reaches PARCEL, so the exit gates stay closed.
common_mistakes.recovery: Step back onto CATCH to reopen the gate and retry with a later throw; the safe bottom floor permits Pac to reset position without losing a life.

common_mistakes.recovery: Wait for the next throw and step off CATCH just after the sac has crossed on the outgoing leg; if an early release blocks the route, re-open CATCH and repeat.
